scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/wknd/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/wknd
  set jcr:title{String} to "WKND Sites Project"
end

create group wknd-repoinit-group with path /home/groups/wknd/repoinit
set properties on authorizable(wknd-repoinit-group)/profile
  set givenName to "WKND Repoinit Group"
  set email to "wknd-repoinit-group@wknd.com"
  set aboutMe to "Group for WKND project."
end

set ACL for wknd-repoinit-group
  allow jcr:read on /
end

create user wknd-repoinit-user with path /home/users/wknd/repoinit with password 123456
set properties on authorizable(wknd-repoinit-user)/profile
  set givenName to "WKND"
  set familyName to "Repoinit User"
  set email to "wknd-repoinit-user@wknd.com"
  set aboutMe to "User for WKND project."
end
